mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM cart WHERE cstmr_id=#{cstmrId} and prdct_id=#{prdctId}

SELECT Z.prdct_id ,prdct_name ,trde_prc ,(select server_url from file_server where isdefault='1') url_str ,(select count(*) from rotate_img where prdct_id=Z.prdct_id AND media_ty_cd='00200002') multi_img_cnt ,(select video_cd from video where prdct_id=Z.prdct_id) video_cd ,Y.img_path ,Y.color ,X.event_id ,X.event_name ,X.dscnt ,B.brand_name FROM prdct Z INNER JOIN cart C ON Z.prdct_id=C.prdct_id AND C.cstmr_id=#{cstmrId} LEFT OUTER JOIN still_img Y on Z.prdct_id=Y.prdct_id LEFT OUTER JOIN ( select * from( select Z.event_id,event_name,dscnt,ifnull(prdct_id,-1) prdct_id from event Z left outer join event_prdct X on Z.event_id = X.event_id where DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y%m%d') between start_time and end_time and event_stat_ty_cd='00500001' order by dscnt desc )A GROUP BY prdct_id ) X ON Z.prdct_id = X.prdct_id or X.prdct_id=-1
INNER JOIN brand B ON Z.brand_id = B.brand_id
WHERE prdct_stat_ty_cd="00100003" and prdct_visible_cd="00500001" and Y.img_path is not null ORDER BY dscnt desc

SELECT * FROM( SELECT ( SELECT count(*) FROM prdct WHERE cart_id=A.cart_id and prdct_stat_ty_cd='00100003' and prdct_visible_cd='00500001' and prdct_ty_cd=#{prdctTyCd} ) cnt ,cart_id ,cart_name FROM cart A )B WHERE cnt>0;
SELECT cart_id ,cart_name ,bigo FROM cart WHERE cart_id=#{cartId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE cstmr_id = #{cstmrId} and prdct_id = #{prdctId};
